flavor.phonemic_palette: near_eastern (old_persian / Axsatran register: the Xshayathiya court, the paridaida walled-paradise garden, Arta-truth and the farnah-glory, the satrapal road, Old-Persian -a/-ah/-iya/-aspa endings, the ezafe genitive-of-relation, flowing a/i/u vowels and the xsh-/sp-/fr- clusters) / mesoamerican (mayan / Ixalan: the witz pyramid-acropolis and the carved stela, the k'uhul-ajaw holy-lord and the Long-Count, the jungle city-state, jade and maize and quetzal-feather, glottalized stops and the final glottal stop, vigesimal counting)

religion_hooks.alignment_lens: Resolved per the culture's chosen alignment (setting-lore): Lawful venerates the Lawful powers and names the Chaotic as demons; Chaotic the reverse; Neutral honors ancestral and local powers, invoking the great powers situationally.

flavor_text.one_line: Xochistan — proselytizing sacerdotal hierocracy of the synthesis; law, honor, valor.
flavor_text.one_paragraph: The Xochistan are a vigorous sacerdotal hierocracy people, a first-order synthesis of Aryastan and Tollanaz [Peer Synthesis / Theocratic]. They prize law, honor, valor, lean toward the military sphere, and field archers, heavy_cavalry, heavy_infantry. Outsiders are met as proselytizing; their patrons touch war.
